description: A one-knob drone voice: an oscillator through a resonant filter and a chorus, with a drive stage in front of the output

params.text: Sets the drive into the distortion stage, which reaches about twenty times at the far right
Sets how fast the animation moves the pitch
Picks the band the animation speed works in
Switches the chorus in and out of the signal path
Sets the harmonic content of the oscillator
Sets the filter resonance, which stops short of self-oscillation
Sets the pitch of the oscillator
Snaps the pitch to whole semitones rather than leaving it continuous

inputs.text: Adds to the drive, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the output level, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the animation speed, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
A voltage above 2.5V switches the chorus in and anything lower switches it out, in place of the switch
Adds to the harmonic content, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the filter frequency, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the filter resonance, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Sets the pitch of the oscillator at a volt per octave, added to the pitch knob
